sloka: युष्माबिः निर्हतो दृष्ट्वा तौ उभौ भ्रातौ रणे ।इयम् प्रहृष्टा मुदिता रुधिरम् युधि पास्यति ॥३-१९-२५॥
transliteration: yuṣmābiḥ nirhato dṛṣṭvā tau ubhau bhrātau raṇe ।iyam prahṛṣṭā muditā rudhiram yudhi pāsyati ॥3-19-25॥

translations.english: Thus commanded, the fourteen demons along with Surpanakha rushed there like windblown clouds.
